diagnostic_context.problem:
I changed my university password this morning.
Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi-Fi,
but my phone still works.
diagnostic_context.likely_cause: Windows laptop is having issues with cached old password for eduroam network after university password change.

answer.diagnosis: Windows laptop is having issues with cached old password for eduroam network after university password change.
steps: Open Settings > Network & Internet > Wi-Fi on your Windows laptop.
Select eduroam, and enter your current university username and password.
If you recently changed your university password, try choosing 'Forget' for the existing eduroam network.
After forgetting the network, reconnect using your new password.
If connection still fails, confirm that your university account is active and try connecting again.
Check if old credentials are stored and remove them.
Update saved passwords in email clients or VPN software if applicable.
